items.title: Live: PM urges end to war with Iran, as government prepares to release millions of litres of fuel
items.description: Several times today, Prime Minister Anthony Albanese has argued Iran's ability to develop a nuclear weapon has been removed, citing "intelligence and statements by the United States". Follow live.

items.title: Oil tankers 'spoofing' their GPS data to get fuel out of Iran
items.description: Changing flags, creating new names, and faking their GPS data, ABC NEWS Verify investigates how Iranian-linked oil tankers continue to export oil during the war.

items.title: Bradley Murdoch provided with 'high level' of attention in prison, inquest told
items.description: Bradley Murdoch took the location of his victim Peter Falconio's remains to his grave. A coronial inquest has revealed police made two desperate attempts to get answers just days before he died.

items.title: Gold-tier health policies set to rise by as much as 25pc next month
items.description: Some Australians with private health insurance will face premium increases of as much as 25 per cent from next month, according to new analysis from CHOICE.

items.title: Live: Wind gusts reach 315km/h as category five Cyclone Narelle nears Qld coast
items.description: Severe Tropical Cyclone Narelle has intensified into a category four system, due to make landfall tomorrow. Follow live

items.title: Danish royals Frederik and Mary greet crowds at Hobart's waterfront
items.description: The Danish royal couple is spending the day in Mary's home state of Tasmania on the final day of their official tour of Australia.

items.title: Live: Understrength Swans face Hawks in MCG clash to open round two
items.description: A Sydney side missing Errol Gulden and Isaac Heeney heads to the MCG to take on Hawthorn in a bid to keep their 100 per cent record alive. Follow live.

items.title: Live: Bulldogs look to shrug off drama-filled week against Raiders
items.description: Canterbury will be aiming to move past the Bronson Xerri saga and stay unbeaten in 2026 when it travels to Canberra to face the Raiders. Follow live.

items.title: Former pro cyclist Rohan Dennis's online post labelled 'deeply offensive'
items.description: A post shared on Instagram by former professional cyclist Rohan Dennis, whose wife died after being struck by a car he was driving, has been described as "deeply offensive".

items.title: Family seeks DNA testing after news of Royal North Shore IVF mix-up
items.description: A family is pursuing DNA testing after hearing about an IVF mix-up at the same Sydney fertility clinic used to conceive its baby.

items.title: Bondi lifeguard-turned-police officer makes dramatic surf rescue at Byron Bay
items.description: A former Bondi Rescue reality TV lifeguard who now works as a police officer in Byron Bay jumped into the surf to rescue three French tourists off a rocky headland.

items.title: Catley declares Asian Cup final 'not mission impossible' for Matildas
items.description: The Matildas aren't daunted by Japan's ominous form ahead of what shapes up as a blockbuster Asian Cup final.

items.title: 'Shouldn't that be enough?' Popovic bemused by Segečić's Croatia call
items.description: Socceroos coach Tony Popovic maintains young players have an opportunity to represent Australia at the highest level despite losing a younger player to a European rival.

items.title: UK abuse claims against Kevin Spacey settled out of court
items.description: Hollywood actor Kevin Spacey avoids a new trial after settling out of court with three men who launched a UK civil suit against him accusing him of sexual assault.

items.title: As UK battles 'unprecedented' outbreak of meningitis, Australia is unprepared
items.description: A growing outbreak of meningococcal B and meningitis has killed two young people in the UK as the number of infections climb. Here's why infectious disease professor Paul Griffin thinks Australia should be worried.

items.title: 'You had to fight tooth and nail': Women reveal abuse in kava gatherings
items.description: Women in Tongan communities speak out against sexual harassment at social events known as "kava gatherings", where men sit in a circle while a female server pours them the drink, known for its calming effects.

items.title: Ryan Gosling is humanity's last hope in this new space epic
items.description: Project Hail Mary hits Australian cinemas this week, joining Oscar-nominated animation Arco, off-the-wall slasher Dolly and BAFTA-winning biopic I Swear.

items.title: Lizzy Hoo's surprising love of Mongolian indie rock
items.description: Comedian Lizzy Hoo loves an adventure, which is how she ended up at a music festival outside Ulaanbaatar watching her new favourite band.

items.title: Power prices set to fall, but Iran war casts long shadow over bill relief
items.description: Benchmark power prices across parts of the country will ease as renewables reduce wholesale costs for electricity, but the regulator warns its modelling does not account for the war in the Middle East.

items.title: Inquiry begins into Hong Kong's deadliest fire in decades
items.description: Evidence during the first hearing into the cause of a Hong Kong apartment complex blaze has heard a series of failures contributed to the deaths of 168 people.

items.title: Australia Zoo, government silent in search for captured totemic crocodile
items.description: Missing: One 80-year-old, 4.5 metre totemic crocodile. Last known whereabouts: Australia Zoo. Welcome to the fight for Old Faithful.

items.title: Podcasts, return to radio could be next for Kyle and Jackie O, experts say
items.description: The collapse of The Kyle and Jackie O Show has left hundreds of thousands of people looking for something else to listen to in the morning, with some industry insiders questioning whether the duo could make a comeback.

items.title: Bundaberg residents want buyback scheme after three major floods in 15 years
items.description: There are calls for the Queensland government to buy back homes in Bundaberg's flood zones, but the disaster recovery minister says the focus is on mitigation measures like floodgates.

items.title: Island council considers total ban on all new pet cats
items.description: Kangaroo Island Council is considering banning the introduction of all cats to the island, in a move the mayor is calling the "last cat policy". If successful, the ban would make the South Australian island one of the world's biggest inhabited islands to be free of cats.

items.title: Trainer quizzed at inquest into jockey's fatal fall
items.description: Marina Morel came to Australia from France to follow her dream of being a professional jockey, but died after the horse she was riding collapsed.
